name: Baal Meon
overview: Baal Meon, also known by several names including Beth-Meon, Beth-Baal-Meon, and Beon, is identified in Scripture as a city belonging to the Reubenites. The city is mentioned among other towns in the territory east of the Jordan River, highlighting its significance in the region's geography and history. The variations in its name reflect its connection to Baal worship, yet its mention in prophetic and historical contexts, such as in Ezekiel and Jeremiah, underscores God's sovereign involvement with the nations and cities surrounding His people.
